user.description: Connect to the Wyoming speech-to-text service used by the Coach pipeline. The entity created here lets the satellite decide when the turn ends.

data_description.max_duration_seconds: Safety backstop. If the satellite never signals the end of the turn, the audio received so far is transcribed after this duration.
